packageRules.description: Keep first-party reusable workflows on their moving compatibility refs.
Dev tools only run in lint and CI, where a breaking release fails the required check. The Go toolchain builds the binary, so it stays manual.
Go modules ship in the binary; the renderer tests pin its output, so only patches merge unattended.
Actions run with the repository token; digest pinning plus the release age delay make patches safe to merge unattended.
